terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Musafir249. These Terms & Conditions describe how you may access and use our booking platform. The content below is placeholder text for demonstration purposes only.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using any part of Musafir249, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, you must not use the platform.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old and capable of entering into a binding agreement. You are responsible for ensuring all information you provide is accurate and up to date.

platformUse.title: 3. Platform Use
platformUse.body: Musafir249 helps you compare and book buses, vans, and private rides. You agree to use the platform only for lawful purposes and not to misuse bookings, payments, or messaging features.

accountsSecurity.title: 4. Accounts and Security
accountsSecurity.body: You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and device. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

bookingsPayments.title: 5. Bookings and Payments
bookingsPayments.body: A booking is confirmed only after successful payment according to the rules shown at checkout. Fares, fees, and cancellation policies may vary by operator and route.

limitationLiability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
limitationLiability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Musafir249 is provided on an "as is" basis. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses arising from your use of the platform while this placeholder policy is in effect.

changesTerms.title: 7. Changes to These Terms
changesTerms.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Continued use of Musafir249 after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains what information Musafir249 may collect, how we use it, and the choices available to you. The content below is placeholder text for demonstration purposes only.

informationCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationCollect.body: We may collect profile details, contact information, trip preferences, payment-related data, device information, and usage data needed to operate the platform securely.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Information
howWeUse.body: We use your information to create and manage accounts, process bookings, improve search and recommendations, prevent fraud, and provide customer support.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing of Information
sharing.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share limited data with operators and service providers who help deliver trips, payments, analytics, or compliance services, subject to appropriate safeguards.

dataRetention.title: 4. Data Retention
dataRetention.body: We retain information for as long as needed to provide the service, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Retention periods may vary by data type.

security.title: 5. Security
security.body: We apply administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect your data. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so please use strong credentials and protect your device.

yourChoices.title: 6. Your Choices
yourChoices.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of certain information where applicable law allows. Some data may need to be retained to satisfy legal or account-closure requirements.

contactUs.title: 7. Contact Us
contactUs.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact our support team through the in-app help channel. This placeholder policy will be replaced with final legal text.
